entities.summary: The Kyūshū K10W was a single engine, low wing fixed undercarriage monoplane training aircraft which served in the Imperial Japanese Navy Air Service in the latter part of World War II. Its full Navy designation was the Type 2 Land-based Intermediate Trainer .
